title: Parity Symmetry Breaking in the 8×8 I-Ching Matrix: A Perspective on Cosmological Circulation
content: This paper explores the mathematical transition of a 64-gram (8 ×8) matrix system from static equilibrium to dynamic circulation. By applying a Riemann-inspired weight operator and a linear phase evolution governed by independent winding numbers k and m, we demonstrate how mirror symmetry is shattered. Drawing upon the theory of Hyperbolic Bias, we examine the evolution from δ = 0 (Hermitian parity) to δ = 3/4 (asymmetric dominance). This transition provides a formal mechanism for the transformation of “Obstruction” (Heaven-Earth) into “Full Circulation” (Earth-Heaven), establishing a mathematical analogue for the Sakharov conditions in Baryogenesis.
